scope_rule: Every repository open PR/branch in the refreshed authoritative inventory must receive an explicit assessed disposition and non-loss reconciliation before cumulative integration is merge-eligible. Include un-PR'd active branches identified by a separately paginated branch census. 'All open' means all open at pre-merge refresh, not just snapshot 2026-11-23.
supersession_rule: Superseded, duplicate, already-merged-by-equivalent-content, blocked, security-risk, and obsolete branches are not silently cherry-picked or deleted; map exact original requirements and affected source to accepted equivalent implementation, deferred blocker, or explicit authorized decision with receipts.
integration_policy: Use PR #914 as cumulative coordinating workstream; preserve existing PRs and branches until explicitly reconciled and verified; do not force-push or rewrite frozen authorities.

Before modification fetch exact authoritative main, PR head/base SHA, merge base, changed files, tests, dependencies, review state and scope for EVERY open PR including older Pass 219/220/221 series and unrelated user artifacts.
Classify dependencies and cycles; derive topological merge order, semantic compatibility, overlapping changes, byte-frozen conflicts, native ABI/version conflicts and deployment impacts.
Reconcile requirements, not simply Git branches: preserve all nonconflicting functionality; detect duplicate/superseded efforts without discarding nonoverlapping features.

Do not bulk-merge untrusted code, expired dependencies, failed CI, malicious changes or secrets; classify BLOCKED and document exact outstanding remediation; security and source-integrity review precedes promotion.
Apply changes into one tested cumulative integration candidate with original contribution provenance; use scoped commits/cherry-picks/patch application and deterministic conflict resolution evidence.

Resolve each filename/contract overlap using requirements coverage and executable tests; canonical VM81/Hash72/Hash216 single authority, exact math, signed admission, Lane 5 hydration and frozen layers unchanged unless explicitly authorized regression-evidenced repairs.
Must include the newly recorded PR914 HC64 DSP, neural particle simulation, GBrain, platformer, professional IDE redesign and full Pass220–222 inherited obligations.

After composing, execute focused checks followed by integration-level frontend/backend/native/CI, source-integrity, browser end-to-end, persisted project load/save, imports/exports, dependency and DigitalOcean staging acceptance.

Only after ALL entries are resolved with green proofs and independent exact-head review can candidate become ready-to-merge; then target main through ordinary reviewed PR with expected SHA. No blind bulk merge and no production promotion from contract-only status.

release_gates.G3: Full Pass220 native IDE, Pass221 independent gates, Pass222 source provenance if found, and complete PR914 integrated workspace coverage audited
release_gates.G4: Native ABI/VM81 exact authority, signed admission, Hash72/Hash216 replay, frozen-layer source hashes, tests and security review green
release_gates.G5: Professional IDE interaction tests (HC64, platformer, particle, GBrain and all configured functional templates) plus production target acceptance green
release_gates.G6: Exact integration candidate head validated against current main; reviewed merge approval and rollback checkpoint with durable evidence
